description: Choose one eBay shipping (fulfillment) policy — or null for the connection default — for up to 25 products on one eBay site, with the same per-product rules as set_product_ebay_fulfillment_policy: no listing stores the choice; a draft or live listing has its offer updated in place and read back. The policy is checked against eBay once before any product is touched, and a product whose listing lives on another eBay site fails with marketplaceMismatch instead of being moved. Returns results per product (status updated, unchanged, saved, unverified or failed with the eBay error), counts and notAttempted (not reached in the time budget — call again with those ids). Refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

fulfillmentPolicyId.description: A fulfillmentPolicyId from list_ebay_fulfillment_policies, for the same marketplace. null removes the product's own choice so the connection default (then eBay's first policy) applies.

marketplaceId.description: The eBay MARKETPLACE id the policy belongs to, such as EBAY_IT. Omit it when the eBay connection sells on one site. A product whose eBay offer lives on another site is reported as failed, never moved.

productIds.description: The products to change, at most 25 ids from search_products.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.

name: bulk_set_ebay_fulfillment_policy
title: Set eBay shipping policy for products
